# The Lord Is My Shepherd (Psalm 23:1-6)

## Emotional Focus
Remembering the Lord is our Shepherd on hard days and quiet ones.

## Key KJV
“The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.” (Psalm 23:1)

## Gentle Retelling (3–8)
The Lord is my Shepherd. He lets me rest in green pastures and leads me beside still waters. Even in dark valleys I do not need to be afraid, because He is with me. His goodness and mercy follow me all my life.
